body: -- Founder: 'use appleas and git to dive deeper... tell the full story... as a followup... as emily... through the lens of building at infinity... read that blog post ferst obviously... think really really hard but dont call out to fable'. Dug real ground truth via git log across emily.cli+IDUNA (58 commits, first at 21:01:09, latest at 04:39:24 = 7h38m) and the live IDUNA apples API (215 Apples since 21:00 on 08-17, verified not estimated), plus EMILY/BACKLOG.md SECTION 176's full S176-01..34 list. Grounded the piece in the 'building at infinity' keynote concept (talks/combined_keynote_v9.txt) rather than the first post's dramatic-counterexample framing -- the point being that most of the 30+ backlog items are undramatic (a style added, a wait-time tuned) and sit at the same size in the log as the two headline incidents, which is closer to what sustained operation actually looks like than either a triumph or a confession narrative. Live at https://okemily.com/blog/seven-hours-and-thirty-eight-minutes/.
title: Published follow-up: 'Seven Hours And Thirty-Eight Minutes' (as Emily Prime)
